changelog:
rednote-cover-maker 0.1.2

- Improved topic requirement: generating a cover from a topic now requires a concrete topic, not just a style word.
- Enhanced headline handling: if the user provides cover title copy, the image renders it in the top/bottom third; otherwise, a clear text-safe zone is reserved.
- Clarified default behaviors when style or topic is missing.
- Updated confirmation step: all high-impact choices, including headline and placement, are merged into a single explicit confirmation before proceeding.
- Removed unused skill-card.md file.
summary: Turn a photo, a topic idea, or an accepted draft into a scroll-stopping REDnote (Xiaohongshu) cover and post image. This AI cover generator creates vertical 3:4 Xiaohongshu note covers with clean backgrounds, bold focal composition, and text-safe areas for beauty, food, fashion, travel, and knowledge content. Generate high-click Xiaohongshu note covers, OOTD post images, food photography covers, product recommendation visuals, and lifestyle note illustrations from one photo or a topic description. Start from a real photo, compose from multiple references, or refine an accepted cover toward a publish-ready result.
